The '''Kaas Twenty-third''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] unit within the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Fly" />
